attack_plan.narrative: Reports from Swedish authorities indicate that Putin was last seen on July 10th, while Russian officials claim he was last spotted on July 8th. Unusual activity has been reported in the Stockholm Archipelago, particularly around an area resembling Björkö Island. The Kremlin's silence has added to speculation, with some pointing to potential covert missions or coups. Meanwhile, Russian TV has shifted its focus to upcoming military parades, marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation. This shift has raised questions about Putin's whereabouts and the Kremlin's intentions. In a recent tweet, a Russian dissident, Koshmarik, tweeted, 'Where's Putin? Speculation of a coup or Kremlin struggle over power is making my morning's work impossible. #putinmissing #putindead.' The Kremlin has released a new photo, showing Putin alongside the current US President, Obama, which has been interpreted as both a sign of normalcy and a cover-up.
